Messages.Body:
3} Ambrosius and Zombie
-----------------------
* If Zombie (or any retainer) which has been brought into play by
Ambrosius is burned before all Pathos counters are removed, it goes
to the ash heap and is *not* removed from the game.
* The retainer "forgets" the Pathos counters that were originally on
it.

LOGIC: Why would cards have counters on them in the ash heap? It
seems like a "fair escape" to me.
